data.description:
The sampling area for the famous Bad Dragon toy line. Customers come here to explore the various size, shapes, colors, models, and functionalities of their many varied tools and toys of the trade. It has a nice calm, mature vibe, and there are sales agents around to help with product display, testing, sampling, and ultimately - in the best case scenario - wrapping up favored products for purchase. It's frowned upon to loiter, but customers won't be rushed out if they linger.

This place is a very large amphitheater that's been transformed into a product testing room as a part of a fancy mall-sized Bad Dragon store. The company is a world famous toy brand, and the store has a strict ID required policy to explore, particularly to enter the sampling room. No exceptions. The showroom is kept dimly lit and covered in black wallpaper and tiles, to give it a fashionable look and make the devices sold there stand out better.

Employees quietly mill about the room near displays to help answer questions from curious or eager customers, as well as give instructions and demonstrations on how to activate and operate the devices on display. While employees are all very polite and courteous, they're encouraged to be prurient and tactile while on the job, especially to customers they talk to. There are many testing booths in the form of small comfortable alcolves on the sides of the the amphitheater-turned-showroom. Most have curtains that can be closed to drown out the chatter of other customers. Employees are not only happy to explain the novelty toys, demonstrate their function, and make recommendations, but they're also fully capable of making a sale and will package up anything requested of them for a fair price. There are both male and female employees.

The store is 24/7 and customers do not have any limits regarding how long they can stay or how many devices they'd like to sample or try before deciding on a purchase.

There is a breathtaking and dizzying array of differing toys, tools and devices on display. Among the various tools of the trade and devices, those also have extreme variety and flexibility depending on the interests and need of the viewing customer. 

There are devices which wriggle and dance hypnotically, devices which spin in drill-like fashion, those with attached hoses and fluid tanks, and those that shake and pulse in time with the soft music played throughout the chambers. Some devices are capable of extending and retracting with the press of a button, changing their size and shape.
